# Rappler

> > Independent news organization covering Philippine politics, governance, natural disasters, and social issues with investigative journalism and multimedia storytelling.

Rappler is a Philippine digital news platform founded by Maria Ressa, known for in-depth coverage of political accountability, Supreme Court proceedings, disaster response, and social movements. The site features original reporting, video blogs, and investigative pieces on governance and current events affecting the Philippines.

## Key Topics

- Philippine Politics
- Supreme Court
- Impeachment Proceedings
- Renato Corona
- Benigno Aquino III (PNoy)
- Natural Disasters
- Tropical Storm Sendong
- Valencia City Floods
- Mindanao
- Disaster Response
- Maria Ressa Vlogs
- Governance and Accountability
- Manila
- Bukidnon

- [Arroyo transfer from St. Luke's to Veterans](https://www.rappler.com/philippines/454-arroyo-transfer-from-st-luke-s-to-veterans): Gloria Arroyo transferred from St. Luke's to Veterans Memorial hospital
